title: Category:Fighter Rainbow Armor
description: Category:Fighter Rainbow Armor — The Townstons wiki
html:
Fighter rainbow armor. Some of these are just a name and a look. The fighter armor ending sets Strength / Agility / Endurance. Extra stats roll and do not change the name. Named pieces can also have baked bonuses that every copy shares.

Plate, scale, splint, and the older named fighter pieces can show from 15 if they are unbanded. The later dedicated fighter class set — Gosh's Shock, Gosh's Awe, Gosh's Reverence, Gosh's Veneration, Gosh's Wonder, and Gosh's Marvel — does not enter the shared drop pool until 35. The bands are on Rainbow Level Bands.

Here are listed all Fighter Rainbow Armor pieces.
